units.source_text: 她低声吟唱，并无真心痛恨之色。

en.t: She sang softly under her breath, showing no sign of truly hating me.

units.source_text: 虽然不禁垂泪，还是羞涩似的小心隐饰。

en.t: Although she could not help shedding tears, she still tried carefully to hide them, as if out of shyness.

units.source_text: 可知她心中虽然恨我薄情，但是形诸颜色，又觉得痛苦。

en.t: I could tell that although she resented my coldheartedness, she also suffered from letting it show on her face.

units.source_text: 我看到这情景，又很安心了。

en.t: Seeing this, I felt quite reassured again.

units.source_text: 此后又有一个时期不去访她。

en.t: After that, I again went for a time without visiting her.

units.source_text: 岂知在这期间她已经销声匿迹，不知去向了！

en.t: Who would have thought that during that time she had already vanished without a trace, her whereabouts unknown!
